profile_text.body:
X Corp is a for-profit startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in Bastrop, Texas. Its site at x.com describes itself as a place to get the full story with all the live commentary, spanning breaking news and entertainment, sports and politics. The sign-in page asks for an email or username, and the footer links to About, Get App, Grok, Help, Terms, Privacy, Cookies, Careers, Ads & Business, Developers, News, US TIDA, and Accessibility, with a 2026 copyright notice for X Corp.

Grok appears among the site's own navigation links, and the harvested text does not describe it further. The company profile lists no products.

The profile records law exposure in Texas with a count of 111. No lawsuits are listed.
